decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of two years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are used.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for the purposes of a health centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No.77251/os/003 Rev A, recevied 14.06.04 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the propsoed buildings shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the erection of the proposed buildings, the developer shall 
provide details that the offsite parking provision of eighty (80) spaces has been secured.  Development shall not take place until the Local Planning Authority has confirmed these details.

Condition : 8 - The developer shall submit a Car Park Management Plan for approval 
to the Local Planning Authority and these plans will need to be approved in writing prior to first occupation of any part of the development.
description: Erection of two temporary buildings and prefabricated plant room and elevational alterations to Block D, and interim parking proposals, associated with the redevelopment of Thelma Golding Health Centre.
